confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Colombo price levels. No live menus, listings, booking pages, or registration records were checked, and July 2026 levels are extrapolated from known patterns. Restaurant meal anchors are the steadiest. Beer, cocktail, and wine are the least certain because of high Sri Lankan alcohol taxes and wide bar pricing. Cocktail and wine_glass were set at about 2.2 to 2.3 times the beer anchor because direct knowledge of local bar and wine-by-the-glass prices is weak. Accommodation assumes registered properties, which was not verified, and the 3-star figure spans a wide range by area and season. Local currency swings in recent years widen the range.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is a South Asian capital-city tourist market, adjusted upward for Colombo's service charges, VAT, and high alcohol taxes. The 3-star tier reflects the Colombo business-hotel market.
